parse.title: Secret Portal
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-SecretPortal.png}} {{E|Secret Portal}} is a shrine [[Event]] found in [[Act 3]]. It will only appear if 800 seconds (13 minutes and 20 seconds) have passed. ==Options== {{Frame|Enter the Portal}} IMMEDIATELY travel to [[Bosses#Act 3 Bosses|the boss]]. * The player is put directly into combat with the [[Bosses#Act 3 Bosses|Act 3 boss]] at the end of the act.
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens. ==Dialogue==
Before you is a sight that seems out of place in the alien landscape around you. Strangely placed into one of the living walls of the Beyond is an enclosed stone entrance filled with a {{TS|purple|up|swirling magical portal.}}

You aren't sure where it leads, but maybe it could speed your journey through the Spire.
{{Frame|Enter the Portal}}
Jumping through the portal, your sense of time and space is completely torn apart.

As you reorient yourself to the new surroundings, you realize that right before you is a fearsome battle.
{{Frame|Leave}}
Careful and cautious seems the better approach for reaching the top of the Spire. Ignoring the portal you continue on.
==Notes== * Apart from the unusual method of entering the boss floor and skipping the rest of Act 3, entering the portal is otherwise a completely normal boss fight. ** {{R|Pantograph}} and {{R|Slaver's Collar}} trigger as expected. ** There will still be the {{Asc|20|double boss afterwards on A20}}. ** Defeating the boss {{Asc|20|(or both bosses)}} will still allow the player to enter [[Acts#Act 4: The Ending|Act 4]] if they have all required [[Mechanics#Keys|Keys]]. Although, the player should be careful to collect the Ruby Key from a [[Rest Site]] prior to the event since they will skip the guaranteed [[Rest Site]] before the boss (which is often relied on as the last opportunity to collect the Ruby Key). * The player's current floor is only increased by 1, which causes them to fight the [[Bosses#Act 3 Bosses|Act 3 Boss]] earlier than the usual floor 50. ==Trivia== * The 800 second minimum time limit in order to encounter this event was implemented after some discussion with the Slay the Spire speedrunning community during the game's development. Without the limit, the fastest winning runs relied on encountering {{E|Secret Portal}} to skip many floors of Act 3. This would offer such an enormous time save that runs which didn't manage to find {{E|Secret Portal}} early enough could never beat runs that did. This requirement means that no speedrun would be able to encounter {{E|Secret Portal}}, while casual runs under normal gameplay would easily satisfy the minimum time requirement and be able to encounter the event as intended. ==Update History== * '''Weekly Patch 51: Recursion''' ** Secret Portal event no longer says Ignored in run history. Run history rows capped at 20 elements. * '''Weekly Patch 40: Forethought''' ** Events: Falling, Secret Portal, Knowing Skull, Golden Idol, and Scrap Ooze receive ambient BGM. * '''Weekly Patch 18: Paranormal''' ** New Event (Beyond): Secret Portal. {{EventNav}} [[Category:Events]]
